_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
Kai ne Dan wasa {player_id} a wasan LinesOfAction.
Kutunka ni '{side}', kutun abokin wasa ni '{other}'.
Tsarin tafiya: `[b1b3]` (daga lakorde zuwa lakorde). Tafiya halali tana tafiya a tsaye, a kwance, ko a diagonal da yawan murabba'i sawa da jumla ya kutu (kowane launi) a cikin layin. Ka iya tsallake kutunka, amma ba kutun abokin wasa; sauka a kan abokin wasa ka kama shi.  Ka yi nasara lokacin da dukkan kutunka suka hada 8-makwabci.

invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: Yahol haani laato laabi mala diagonal.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: Haani ɓe yahra dabare je ɗon fotti be kujeji ha nder laral.
invalid_move.destination_own: Wuro je ɓe yahata ɗon mari kuje maɓɓe.

game_action.captured_suffix: Dan wasa {player_id} ya tafi {from} -> {to} ya kama abokin wasa.
